gpt5_cloudsbackground.name: Clouds Background (WebGPU)
gpt5_cloudsbackground.description: Procedural drifting clouds with adjustable density, scale, wind and opacity. WebGL+WebGPU. Uses layout-space so it scrolls with the camera.

speedX.name: Wind X (px/s)
speedX.desc: Horizontal drift speed in pixels per second.

speedY.name: Wind Y (px/s)
speedY.desc: Vertical drift speed in pixels per second.

skyTint.name: Sky tint
skyTint.desc: How much sky gradient tints the clouds.

mask.name: Mask by transparency
mask.desc: 0 = ignore (full rect). 100 = render only where the layer/object is transparent.

maskInv.name: Mask invert (legacy)
maskInv.desc: Legacy invert parameter kept for backward compatibility.

maskinv.name: Mask invert
maskinv.desc: 0 = render on transparent pixels, 100% = render on opaque pixels (when Mask is enabled).
